name: Teach me how to love!
source:
In this short visual novel, you summon Vaiden — a cunning incubus, hoping to win your crush’s affection. 

But when he flips the question back to you, things take an unexpected turn. What do you love about yourself?

Sometimes, the love spells isn’t about making someone love you , it’s about remembering how to love yourself first. 

[From [url=https://rossaredflyn.itch.io/teach-me-how-to-love]itch.io[/url]]
